Stock market news | Mahanadi Coalfields lists at 2% discount to ₹136 IPO

Mahanadi Coalfields, a Coal India subsidiary, listed on 27 November 2026, offering 66.18 crore shares at ₹136, raising ₹9,000 crore, with Coal India offloading 10% stake. Issue was subscribed 1.52 times. The listing values the company near ₹90,000 crore and adds a new energy stock to the market, though it opened at a modest 2% discount to the IPO price.
